explainer.counted: Sudanese refugees in South Sudan on 31 December 2025, as reported to UNHCR.
explainer.type: A stock: people present at the end of the year, not the number who arrived that year.
explainer.not_included: Asylum seekers, people never registered, and people counted under other groups.

footnotes.fn_2013f394: The reported figure is a preliminary estimate of persons of undetermined nationality by UNHCR. A previous estimate of 18,000 was revised, as UNHCR expects that more people in South Sudan will need help confirming their nationality in the future. Therefore, at the end of 2025, about 60,600 additional people are estimated to be at risk of statelessness and in need of support. These figures do not represent the number of stateless people, but rather those UNHCR expects to assist in confirming their nationality.
footnotes.fn_4a995f10: The reported figure is a preliminary estimate of persons of undetermined nationality by UNHCR. The estimate is based on the UNHCR 2018 statelessness study which documents specific profiles of groups at risk of statelessness in South Sudan.
